title: Detailed camera
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Camera body -->
  <rect x="12" y="30" width="76" height="50" rx="8" fill="#3a6ea5"/>
  <!-- Top body highlight -->
  <rect x="12" y="30" width="76" height="12" rx="8" fill="#5b8fc9"/>
  <!-- Grip texture left -->
  <rect x="12" y="42" width="16" height="38" rx="4" fill="#2c5282"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="46" x2="16" y2="76" stroke="#4a7ab5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="21" y1="46" x2="21" y2="76" stroke="#4a7ab5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="26" y1="46" x2="26" y2="76" stroke="#4a7ab5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Viewfinder hump -->
  <rect x="34" y="20" width="30" height="14" rx="4" fill="#2c5282"/>
  <rect x="38" y="23" width="22" height="8" rx="2" fill="#1a365d"/>
  <!-- Shutter button -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="28" r="5" fill="#ef4444"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="27" r="3" fill="#f87171"/>
  <!-- Mode dial -->
  <circle cx="84" cy="34" r="4" fill="#94a3b8"/>
  <line x1="84" y1="30" x2="84" y2="32" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="58" r="22" fill="#1e293b"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="58" r="22" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Lens inner ring -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="58" r="17" fill="#0f172a"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="58" r="17" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Lens glass -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="58" r="12" fill="#1e3a5f"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="58" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Lens reflection -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="53" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#60a5fa" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="62" r="2" fill="#93c5fd" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Lens aperture blades hint -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="58" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Flash hotshoe -->
  <rect x="40" y="16" width="18" height="5" rx="1" fill="#94a3b8"/>
  <rect x="44" y="13" width="10" height="4" rx="1" fill="#cbd5e1"/>
  <!-- Flash unit -->
  <rect x="30" y="18" width="8" height="6" rx="1" fill="#e2e8f0"/>
  <rect x="31" y="19" width="6" height="4" rx="0.5" fill="#fef9c3"/>
  <!-- Strap lug left -->
  <rect x="10" y="38" width="5" height="8" rx="2" fill="#475569"/>
  <!-- Strap lug right -->
  <rect x="85" y="38" width="5" height="8" rx="2" fill="#475569"/>
  <!-- Bottom detail -->
  <rect x="20" y="78" width="10" height="3" rx="1" fill="#1e293b"/>
  <rect x="70" y="78" width="10" height="3" rx="1" fill="#1e293b"/>
  <!-- Small indicator LED -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="46" r="2" fill="#22c55e"/>
  <!-- AF assist light -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="36" r="2" fill="#fbbf24"/>
</svg>
